item.subject: maths
item.stem:
Pallavi looks at the diagram. She has drawn base $DE$ of length $7\,\mathrm{cm}$. She must build triangle $DEF$ with $DF = 6\,\mathrm{cm}$ and $EF = 5\,\mathrm{cm}$.

Where should she place point $F$?

options.A: At a meeting point of an arc from $D$ of radius $6\,\mathrm{cm}$ and an arc from $E$ of radius $5\,\mathrm{cm}$.
options.B: Anywhere on the dashed arc drawn from $D$, because that arc is labelled first.
options.C: On the midpoint of segment $DE$, because $DE$ is the drawn base.
options.D: At endpoint $E$, because $E$ already sits on the base.
